import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [95.5, 87.2, 92.1]
}
df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data))

# Convert user_id to Int32 and score to Float32
df_converted = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
])

print(df_converted)
print("\nSchema:")
print(df_converted.schema)
